name: Jawesome Date
source:
You play as an awesome shark at a restaurant. It's their first date and he wants to impress the cute guy in front of him. But it will be a challenge, because  he also really really wants to eat him ! Tough choice...

[From [url=https://jawesome-date.itch.io/jawesome-date] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一条很酷的鲨鱼，在餐厅里迎来第一次约会。他想给面前可爱的男人留下好印象。但这会是一个挑战，因为他真的、真的很想把对方吃掉！艰难的选择……

（来源：[url=https://jawesome-date.itch.io/jawesome-date]itch.io[/url]）
